share_price.label: Share price (close)
share_price.definition: Closing price of one common share on the stated listing and date.

average_daily_volume.label: Average daily traded volume
average_daily_volume.definition: Average shares traded per day over the stated window, as given in the uploaded file.

shares_outstanding_basic.label: Basic shares outstanding
shares_outstanding_basic.definition: Issued and outstanding common shares on the stated date. Excludes warrants, options and other convertibles.

warrants_outstanding.label: Warrants outstanding (tranche)
warrants_outstanding.definition: Number of warrants in one tranche, with its exercise price and expiry. Exercise proceeds are hypothetical, not cash held.

options_outstanding.label: Options outstanding (tranche)
options_outstanding.definition: Number of stock options in one tranche with its exercise price.

cash_unrestricted.label: Cash and cash equivalents (unrestricted)
cash_unrestricted.definition: Unrestricted cash and cash equivalents on the stated balance-sheet date. Dated cash is not current cash.
cash_unrestricted.caution: Restricted cash is a separate metric and is excluded from enterprise value.

cash_restricted.label: Restricted cash
cash_restricted.definition: Cash subject to restrictions (e.g. reclamation bonds) on the stated date.

total_debt.label: Total debt
total_debt.definition: Borrowings (loans, notes, drawn facilities) on the stated date. A disclosed 'no debt' is recorded as zero; silence is recorded as unknown.

period_cash_outflow.label: Cash used in operating and investing activities
period_cash_outflow.definition: Cash used in operating and investing activities over the stated period.

resource_tonnage.label: Mineral resource tonnage
resource_tonnage.definition: Tonnes in one resource category, on the stated effective date and basis.

resource_grade.label: Mineral resource grade
resource_grade.definition: Average grade for one resource category.

resource_contained_metal.label: Mineral resource contained metal
resource_contained_metal.definition: Contained metal in one resource category. Categories are never added together automatically; Inferred is never combined with Measured & Indicated.
resource_contained_metal.caution: Mineral resources are not mineral reserves and do not have demonstrated economic viability.

reserve_tonnage.label: Mineral reserve tonnage
reserve_tonnage.definition: Tonnes in one reserve category (Proven/Probable only).

reserve_grade.label: Mineral reserve grade
reserve_grade.definition: Average grade for one reserve category.

reserve_contained_metal.label: Mineral reserve contained metal
reserve_contained_metal.definition: Contained metal in one reserve category (Proven/Probable only).

historical_estimate_contained_metal.label: Historical estimate (not current)
historical_estimate_contained_metal.definition: A historical estimate that a qualified person has not classified as a current mineral resource. Never compared with current estimates.

npv.label: Net present value (study)
npv.definition: Study NPV with its tax basis, discount rate, commodity-price case, study type and effective date. Project NPV is not company equity value.
npv.caution: A PEA may include Inferred resources and is preliminary in nature.

irr.label: Internal rate of return (study)
irr.definition: Study IRR with tax basis and price case.

initial_capex.label: Initial capital cost (study)
initial_capex.definition: Pre-production capital estimate from the stated study.

aisc.label: All-in sustaining cost (study or reported)
aisc.definition: AISC per ounce as defined by the issuer. Definitions differ between issuers; values are compared only with that caveat shown.

commodity_price_assumption.label: Commodity price assumption (study base case)
commodity_price_assumption.definition: Base-case commodity price used by the study.

met_test_recovery.label: Metallurgical test recovery
met_test_recovery.definition: Recovery measured in laboratory testwork under the stated test conditions. Not the same as proposed plant performance.

plant_recovery_assumption.label: Process recovery assumed in study
plant_recovery_assumption.definition: Recovery assumed for the proposed plant in a study.

drill_intercept_length.label: Drill intercept length (core length)
drill_intercept_length.definition: Down-hole sample length. Not true width. Where true width is unknown it stays unknown.

drill_intercept_grade.label: Drill intercept grade
drill_intercept_grade.definition: Grade over the stated down-hole interval.

true_width.label: True width (explicitly stated)
true_width.definition: True thickness, only when the source states it explicitly.

permit_status.label: Permit / authorization status
permit_status.definition: Status of a named authorization. Application, acceptance for review, conditional approval and issuance are distinct states.

ownership_interest.label: Ownership interest in project
ownership_interest.definition: The company's percentage interest in the project on the stated date.

disclosure_signal.label: Disclosure signal
disclosure_signal.definition: A specific disclosure (e.g. going-concern material uncertainty) quoted from the source. It prompts diligence; it is not a verdict.

evidence_types.observed: Measured/observed (e.g. a market price on a stated date)
evidence_types.reported: Reported by the issuer or a named third party
evidence_types.calculated: Calculated by this application from recorded inputs
evidence_types.forecast: Estimate or forecast (study economics, management targets)

workflow_states.candidate: Candidate — proposed by extraction; no checks completed
workflow_states.source_matched: Source-matched — the quoted text was found at the cited location and the automated identity/period/unit checks passed. Not independently verified.
workflow_states.needs_review: Needs review — at least one automated check could not be completed
workflow_states.conflicting: Conflicting — another source reports a different value for the same defined metric
workflow_states.reviewer_approved: Reviewer-approved — a reviewer confirmed the extraction matches the source. This does not independently establish the underlying geological, legal or commercial claim.
workflow_states.superseded: Superseded — replaced by a later correction or restatement (preserved)
workflow_states.rejected: Rejected — failed a check or was rejected by a reviewer (preserved)

risk_statuses.open_question: Open question — not an established adverse finding
risk_statuses.documented_finding: Documented finding — supported by cited evidence and reviewer-confirmed

calculations.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN at display only; stored outputs keep full Decimal precision (34 digits)

market_cap.label: Basic market capitalisation
market_cap.definition: Price on a stated date times basic shares on a stated date. Not enterprise value. Excludes warrants, options and convertibles.

enterprise_value.label: Enterprise value (explicit bridge)
enterprise_value.expression: market_cap + total_debt − unrestricted_cash (each converted with a stated FX rate if needed)
enterprise_value.definition: Each component is dated. Restricted cash is excluded. Warrant proceeds are not added. No other adjustments unless entered as assumptions.

diluted_shares.label: Diluted share scenario
diluted_shares.definition: Scenario: which tranches are assumed exercised is a stated parameter. Exercise proceeds are reported separately as hypothetical and are not cash held.

runway.label: Cash runway scenario (from the cash date)
runway.definition: Months from the balance-sheet date, not from today. Spending is an assumption or a historical average; future spending may differ.

attributable_npv.label: Attributable share of reported project NPV
attributable_npv.definition: Not company equity value. Excludes corporate costs, cash, debt, financing dilution, corporate taxes and the time and risk to reach production.

equity_bridge.label: Project-to-equity bridge (analyst scenario)
equity_bridge.definition: Computed only when every component is specified. A scenario, not a price target or a recommendation.

ev_per_contained_oz.label: EV per contained ounce (single category set)
ev_per_contained_oz.definition: Uses one category set only (M&I, or P&P). Inferred is never added. Basis (100% or attributable) and effective date are stated.

inferred_share.label: Inferred share of reported resource ounces
inferred_share.definition: Objective composition ratio on one effective date and basis. Not a quality grade.

liquidity_days.label: Days to trade a position at stated participation rates
liquidity_days.definition: Mechanical scenario over the stated ADV window. Market impact, liquidity changes and block trades are not modelled; there is no universally valid exit estimate.

fx_convert.label: Currency conversion
fx_convert.definition: Uses an analyst-entered rate with its source and date.
